scope: Offline recorder and explicit officer-answer checks; not a rehearsal verdict.
inputs: Existing mini-kit NYC GeoJSON and Tweed GeoPackage: sizes and SHA-256 verified by unchanged tests.
Fake batch/map pages: JSON 502/422, non-JSON 404, failed request and private URL/body controls.
Synthetic CityGML parent and standalone GeoJSON layer: own fields, Position and unmatched selectors.
safety: No runtime, provider, GPU or Docker operation; no closed-kit contents accessed.
Product code, original manifest reader and closed-kit admission rules unchanged.
decisions: Network records: time, method, path template, query keys, status, structured error code and page label/path.
Published API route literals stay readable; unknown segments are redacted; summary groups path/status.
Failed requests have null status/code; no request/response bodies, header values or URL values are retained.
Answers add optional one-based layer to parent file. Existing omissions GET supplies ordinal/source ID.
No filename inference: missing/ambiguous targets are reported in officerAnswers.matches without a press.
Layer reads share a 10-second parent cooldown, including failures. Matched row IDs are pinned.
Converted rows reuse exact-option/Position rules and rehearsal officer provenance.
Extended validation uses the owned officer module and existing canonical-path/runtime guards.
checkNote: Initial shared wrapper timed out at 200s; a separate baseline server run completed with exit 0.
gaps: Offline proof only; live behavior awaits the next authorized rehearsal.
